tools.name: liveagent_get_api_privileges
tools.description: Show which permissions the connected API key has. Use it first to see which tools the key can call. GET /api/privileges.

tools.name: liveagent_list_tickets
tools.description: List tickets with status, department, agent, subject and dates. Use filters for status, department or dates, because one query returns at most 10 000 records. GET /tickets.

tools.name: liveagent_get_ticket
tools.description: Get one ticket with its status, department, agent, tags and custom fields. GET /tickets/{ticketId}.

tools.name: liveagent_get_ticket_messages
tools.description: Get the message groups (conversation messages) of one ticket. GET /tickets/{ticketId}/messages.

tools.name: liveagent_get_ticket_history
tools.description: Get the change history (status, agent and department changes) of one ticket. GET /tickets/{ticketId}/history.

tools.name: liveagent_get_ticket_sla
tools.description: Get the SLA (service level) state of one ticket: due times and breaches. GET /tickets/{ticketId}/sla.

tools.name: liveagent_list_contacts
tools.description: List customer contacts (requesters) with their name, email and company. GET /contacts.

tools.name: liveagent_get_contact
tools.description: Get one customer contact with its details and custom fields. GET /contacts/{contactId}.

tools.name: liveagent_list_agents
tools.description: List support agents (staff users) with their names, roles and status. GET /agents.

tools.name: liveagent_get_agent
tools.description: Get one agent with their departments, groups and settings. GET /agents/{userId}.

tools.name: liveagent_list_departments
tools.description: List departments (queues that tickets are routed to). GET /departments.

tools.name: liveagent_list_groups
tools.description: List agent groups (teams of agents used for routing and permissions). GET /groups.

tools.name: liveagent_list_companies
tools.description: List customer companies (organizations that contacts belong to). GET /companies.

tools.name: liveagent_list_tags
tools.description: List ticket tags that agents use to label and filter tickets. GET /tags.

tools.name: liveagent_list_predefined_answers
tools.description: List predefined answers (saved reply templates) that agents insert into tickets. GET /predefined_answers.

tools.name: liveagent_create_ticket
tools.description: Create a ticket for a customer. By default it sends no email to the customer (doNotSendMail is Y); set it to N only when the user asks to notify the customer. POST /tickets.

tools.name: liveagent_update_ticket
tools.description: Change a ticket's status, department, agent, subject or tags. Only the fields you pass change. PUT /tickets/{ticketId}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: liveagent_list_tickets, liveagent_get_ticket, liveagent_get_ticket_messages, liveagent_get_ticket_history, liveagent_get_ticket_sla, liveagent_list_contacts, liveagent_list_departments, liveagent_list_tags, liveagent_list_predefined_answers · Private data: liveagent_get_api_privileges, liveagent_list_tickets, liveagent_list_contacts, liveagent_get_contact, liveagent_list_companies · Public sink: liveagent_list_contacts, liveagent_create_ticket.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: liveagent_list_tickets, liveagent_get_ticket, liveagent_get_ticket_messages, liveagent_get_ticket_history, liveagent_get_ticket_sla, liveagent_list_contacts, liveagent_list_departments, liveagent_list_tags, liveagent_list_predefined_answers · Private data: liveagent_get_api_privileges, liveagent_list_tickets, liveagent_list_contacts, liveagent_get_contact, liveagent_list_companies · Public sink: liveagent_list_contacts, liveagent_create_ticket

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
